acceptedInterpretation: Implement the mechanical proof layer for degraded fallback eligibility: availability means canonical CLI executable/version-responsive; single-host-environment and temporary-host-unavailability require fresh probe evidence showing fewer than two available hosts, while explicit-human-approval remains an explicit lower-assurance override with approvalRef.
notes: This resolves the apparent collision between version-responsive CLI availability and deeper auth/quota readiness by keeping this story at the executable/version proof layer and requiring explicit-human-approval for deliberate lower-assurance override.
